mentions.name: Battlefield 6 realism mod
mentions.description: A realism-focused game mod for Battlefield 6 aimed at players of military sim (milsim) titles such as Project Reality, Squad, and Arma. It is built with the game's official modding tooling, which uses TypeScript to hook into in-game events and functions. The current work in progress is an insurgency game mode in which one team defends caches using guerilla tactics while a smaller opposing team has the advantage of firepower and vehicles, with a hoped-for release by Christmas.
mentions.audience: Players of military sim (Milsim) games like Project Reality, Squad or Arma
mentions.source_excerpt:
Making a realism game mod to Battlefield 6, which recently came out.

If you have played military sim (Milsim) games like Project Reality, Squad or Arma you might appreciate it.

Its quite cool how the game devs have made a lot of tooling to use; they use Typescript to hook into in-game events and functions.

There is a whole community making lots of content too:- https://bfportal.gg/

Currently I am working on an insurgency game mode; where one team has to defend some caches and use guerilla tactics, whilst the other team has a smaller size but the advantage of firepower and vehicles.
